            offset = offset * 2

            mean_fp32 = sdata[0] / T.Cast("float32", N)
            out[0] = T.Cast("float16", mean_fp32)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------

        mod = tvm.IRModule({"mse_fp16_one_block": mse_fp16_one_block})
